EC1: Patients having had an ophthalmic surgical procedure within 6 months of the beginning of the study.
EC2: Patients with a diagnosis of glaucoma
EC3: Any abnormality of the cornea which may prevent reliable applanation tonometry
EC4: Known allergy/ h [OR]ypersensitivity re [AND]action to Brimonidine
EC5: Contra-indication to  [AND]Brimonidine including patients on monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MOA)
EC6: Patients unwilling or unable to provide informed consent
